pages.title: Home, Piece by Piece
pages.text: Turn your own trading income into an improvement to the base.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Choose an affordable eligible block in the market and complete the purchase. The normal economy owns its price and delivery.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: The system market shows current prices, stock, categories and search; buys/sales are server-committed. Old player shops and Buyer are retired.
